description:
Check a blueprint before generating it: every error said as what to change, the design traps it
    falls into (a column that will round away, a copy of a value not made yet, a window that counts
    nothing), its size against your row cap, and a small preview run (a few thousand rows) with the
    verifier's findings and sample rows, so you can see the data behave before the real call. Free.

    Returns:
        valid (false while `errors` lists anything generate_dataset would refuse: a slip in the design, a size past the
        row cap, or what stops the preview making any rows), errors (fix these), warnings (read these; a field of the
        language no guide teaches yet is named "not yet supported on this route", and the design still builds), planned
        (sizes the stated numbers set; "keep_size" on a table keeps its row_count), estimated_rows, row_cap,
        preview: {passed, findings, tables: {name: first rows}} when `preview`.
name: validate_blueprint
title: Validate a blueprint
